narration: For the first {identical_months} months, the two lives are the same life. In month {fork_month}, you chose {real_choice} and the ghost took {ghost_choice}. From there, the ghost's money sat above yours for {ghost_ahead_months} months. When the layoff came in month {layoff_month}, the ghost was holding {layoff_net_worth_gap}. The money was furthest apart in month {widest_gap_month}, the last, where the ghost ended with {net_worth_gap}. Its Safety finished {safety_gap}, a little more road to walk with no pay coming in.
